remarks: ALL BEST AND FINAL OFFERS DUE on Sunday, 6/15 at 5PM!!! Welcome to 10 Dry Hill Ct, a wonderful Wolfpit community of alike homes in Norwalk enjoying the serenity, peace and quiet right on a fabulous cul-de-sac. This amazingly well maintained, loved and cared for 3BD, 2BR home offers an immense list of upgrades that is sure to wow you, brand new fence, driveway, hot water heater only a few days old, updated kitchen, quartz countertops, solid oak floors throughout all built to last a lifetime JUST A FEW TO NAME. The home has also been painted inside and out. It offers central A/C, Marvin and Andersen windows, Audio system and all TVs stay. This is a CONTEMPORARY style living with kitchen, DR and LR open floor plan conveniently accessible to the laundry room and the garage with epoxy floors just done days ago as well as an oversized covered deck with grill and smoker also included in the sale. Crown moldings throughout, all closet's backings are custom made with cedar wood. This is also an excellent set up for an in-law or nanny suite with two great size bedrooms sharing a full BR upstairs and the third BD downstairs with another full BR. The craftsmanship of work done screams PERFECTION!!!Professionally manicured yard with many mature plantings, one car attached garage and storage shed are the cherry on the top. Walk to Stew Leonard's or Westport stores, minutes to Calf Pasture Beach, convenient to Merritt and I-95. MOST FURNISHINGS CONVEY WITH THE SALE!!! See Supplements!
